examples.en: My mentor at work taught me how to write professional emails.
examples.zh: 我在公司的導師教我怎麼寫專業的電子郵件。

examples.en: Every new student at the school gets a mentor in the upper grades.
examples.zh: 學校裡每位新生都會有一位高年級的學長姊當導師。

examples.en: She has been a mentor to many young teachers.
examples.zh: 她一直是許多年輕教師的良師。

examples.en: Senior engineers mentor the new employees during their first year.
examples.zh: 資深工程師在新進員工的第一年擔任他們的導師。

examples.en: He volunteers to mentor students who need help with math.
examples.zh: 他自願指導需要數學協助的學生。

examples.en: She mentored me through my first big project.
examples.zh: 她陪著我走過第一個大型專案，一路給我指導。

examples.en: The mortality rate for this disease has dropped sharply in recent years.
examples.zh: 這種疾病的死亡率近幾年大幅下降。

examples.en: Better hospitals have lowered infant mortality across the country.
examples.zh: 更好的醫院降低了全國的嬰兒死亡率。

examples.en: Visiting the old town reminded him of his own mortality.
examples.zh: 造訪老城區讓他想起自己終究難免一死。

examples.en: She works for a nonprofit organization that helps stray dogs.
examples.zh: 她在一個幫助流浪狗的非營利組織工作。

examples.en: Our school library is run by a nonprofit group.
examples.zh: 我們學校的圖書館由一個非營利團體經營。

examples.en: The nonprofit hospital offers free checkups to elderly people.
examples.zh: 這家非營利醫院提供老年人免費健康檢查。

examples.en: The nonprofit raised enough money to build a new playground.
examples.zh: 這個非營利組織募到足夠的錢蓋一座新的遊樂場。

examples.en: Many nonprofits depend on volunteers to run their programs.
examples.zh: 許多非營利組織仰賴志工來推動各項計畫。

examples.en: He left his job to start a nonprofit for young artists.
examples.zh: 他辭掉工作，為年輕藝術家創辦了一個非營利組織。

senses.zh: 擺放位置；分班；就業安置

examples.en: The placement of the sofa makes the living room feel bigger.
examples.zh: 沙發擺放的位置讓客廳感覺比較大。

examples.en: Students take a test for class placement at the start of the term.
examples.zh: 學生在學期初要參加分班測驗。

examples.en: The agency helps with job placement for recent graduates.
examples.zh: 這家機構協助應屆畢業生就業。

examples.en: Most respondents said they prefer taking the MRT to work.
examples.zh: 大多數受訪者表示他們比較喜歡搭捷運上班。

examples.en: Each respondent must answer ten questions about school lunches.
examples.zh: 每位受訪者都必須回答十個關於學校午餐的問題。

examples.en: The respondent in the case agreed to attend the hearing.
examples.zh: 這件案子的被告同意出席聽證會。

examples.en: The sensor turns on the light when someone walks in.
examples.zh: 有人走進來時，感應器就會把燈打開。

examples.en: This sensor measures the temperature of the water.
examples.zh: 這個感測器可以測量水的溫度。

examples.en: Our new phone has a sensor that detects your fingerprint.
examples.zh: 我們的新手機有一個可以辨識指紋的感應器。

examples.en: She tucked a loose strand of hair behind her ear.
examples.zh: 她把一縷散落的頭髮塞到耳後。

examples.en: The spider hung from a single strand of silk.
examples.zh: 那隻蜘蛛掛在一條蜘蛛絲上。

examples.en: Each strand of the rope is made of strong fibers.
examples.zh: 這條繩子的每一股都是用堅韌的纖維製成的。

examples.en: The heavy snow stranded many travelers at the airport.
examples.zh: 大雪使許多旅客受困在機場。

examples.en: Low tide stranded the boat on a sandbank near the shore.
examples.zh: 退潮使那艘船擱淺在近岸的沙洲上。

examples.en: We were stranded in the village after the bridge collapsed.
examples.zh: 橋斷了之後，我們被困在那個村莊。

examples.en: This restaurant is supposedly the best in town.
examples.zh: 據說這家餐廳是鎮上最好的。

examples.en: He was supposedly studying, but I heard loud music from his room.
examples.zh: 據說他在讀書，可是我聽見他房間傳出很大的音樂聲。

examples.en: The bridge is supposedly safe, but I still feel nervous.
examples.zh: 這座橋據稱很安全，但我還是覺得緊張。

examples.en: He studied theology at university before becoming a teacher.
examples.zh: 他在成為老師之前，先在大學修讀神學。

examples.en: The library has a large collection of books on theology.
examples.zh: 這間圖書館有大量的神學書籍。

examples.en: She gave a talk on the history of Christian theology.
examples.zh: 她做了一場關於基督教神學歷史的演講。

examples.en: She is undoubtedly the best singer in our class.
examples.zh: 她無疑是我們班上唱得最好的人。

examples.en: This is undoubtedly a good time to buy a new laptop.
examples.zh: 現在無疑是買新筆電的好時機。

examples.en: The team was undoubtedly tired after the long trip.
examples.zh: 經過長途旅行，這支隊伍無疑很累。

examples.en: She keeps her socks in the top drawer of the dresser.
examples.zh: 她把襪子放在五斗櫃最上面的抽屜裡。

examples.en: There is a mirror above the dresser in my bedroom.
examples.zh: 我臥室的梳妝臺上方有一面鏡子。

examples.en: We bought a wooden dresser for the baby's room.
examples.zh: 我們為寶寶的房間買了一個木製五斗櫃。

examples.en: Please buy a liter of milk on your way home.
examples.zh: 你回家的路上請買一公升的牛奶。

examples.en: This bottle holds about half a liter of water.
examples.zh: 這個瓶子大約可以裝半公升的水。

examples.en: The car uses one liter of gas for every twelve kilometers.
examples.zh: 這輛車每跑十二公里要用一公升的汽油。

examples.en: The sneaky cat stole a piece of fish from the table.
examples.zh: 那隻狡猾的貓從桌上偷了一塊魚。

examples.en: He gave me a sneaky smile before he opened the gift.
examples.zh: 他在拆禮物之前對我露出一抹狡黠的微笑。

examples.en: It was sneaky of her to read my diary.
examples.zh: 她偷看我的日記，真是偷偷摸摸。

examples.en: I bought some new stationery before the school year started.
examples.zh: 開學前我買了一些新文具。

examples.en: The store sells pens, notebooks, and other stationery.
examples.zh: 這家店賣筆、筆記本和其他文具。

examples.en: She wrote the invitation on pretty pink stationery.
examples.zh: 她把邀請函寫在漂亮的粉紅色信紙上。

examples.en: Students walk through the underpass to get to the school gate.
examples.zh: 學生穿過地下道走到學校大門。

examples.en: The underpass floods whenever it rains heavily.
examples.zh: 每次下大雨，這條地下道都會淹水。

examples.en: A new underpass will help reduce traffic near the station.
examples.zh: 一條新的地下道將有助於減少車站附近的車流。

examples.en: I keep my gym clothes in my locker at school.
examples.zh: 我把體育服放在學校的置物櫃裡。

examples.en: Please put your bag in a locker before entering the museum.
examples.zh: 進入博物館之前，請把包包放進寄物櫃。

examples.en: He forgot the combination to his locker after summer vacation.
examples.zh: 暑假過後，他忘了置物櫃的密碼。

examples.en: I need a new pair of sneakers for gym class.
examples.zh: 我需要一雙新的運動鞋來上體育課。

examples.en: These white sneakers go well with jeans.
examples.zh: 這雙白色球鞋跟牛仔褲很搭。

examples.en: He tied the laces of his sneaker and started to run.
examples.zh: 他綁好球鞋的鞋帶，開始跑步。

examples.en: She studied music at a famous academy in Vienna.
examples.zh: 她在維也納一所著名的音樂學院學習音樂。

examples.en: The police academy trains new officers for two years.
examples.zh: 警察學院為新進警員提供為期兩年的訓練。

examples.en: The Academy of Sciences holds a public lecture every month.
examples.zh: 科學院每個月都會舉辦一場公開演講。

examples.en: The farm covers about fifty acres of land.
examples.zh: 這座農場占地約五十英畝。

examples.en: They bought an acre of land near the lake.
examples.zh: 他們在湖邊買了一英畝的土地。

examples.en: The park is ten acres in size, with a large pond in the middle.
examples.zh: 這座公園有十英畝大，中間有一座大池塘。

examples.en: The village is at an altitude of two thousand meters.
examples.zh: 這個村莊海拔兩千公尺。

examples.en: The plane climbed to a cruising altitude of ten thousand meters.
examples.zh: 飛機爬升到一萬公尺的巡航高度。

examples.en: Some hikers feel dizzy at high altitude.
examples.zh: 有些登山客在高海拔地區會覺得頭暈。

examples.en: The children played happily amid the colorful flowers.
examples.zh: 孩子們在五顏六色的花叢中開心地玩耍。

examples.en: She stayed calm amid all the noise and confusion.
examples.zh: 在一片吵雜與混亂之中，她依然保持冷靜。

examples.en: Prices keep rising amid worries about the economy.
examples.zh: 在對經濟的擔憂之中，物價持續上漲。

examples.en: The audience stood up to applaud the singer.
examples.zh: 觀眾起立為那位歌手鼓掌。

examples.en: Everyone applauded when the winner walked on stage.
examples.zh: 優勝者走上舞臺時，大家都鼓掌歡迎。

examples.en: Teachers applaud students who work hard and help others.
examples.zh: 老師稱讚那些用功又樂於助人的學生。

examples.en: My little brother is learning basic arithmetic in first grade.
examples.zh: 我弟弟一年級就在學基本的算術。

examples.en: Mental arithmetic helps you check the bill quickly.
examples.zh: 心算可以幫你很快核對帳單。

examples.en: Addition and subtraction are the simplest forms of arithmetic.
examples.zh: 加法和減法是最簡單的算術。

examples.en: The balloon slowly began to ascend into the sky.
examples.zh: 氣球慢慢開始升向天空。

examples.en: We ascended the stairs to the top floor of the tower.
examples.zh: 我們沿著階梯登上塔的頂樓。

examples.en: The climbers ascend the mountain early in the morning.
examples.zh: 登山客在清晨攀登這座山。

examples.en: The museum has an exhibit about the plot to assassinate the king.
examples.zh: 博物館有一個關於暗殺國王陰謀的展覽。

examples.en: Historians still discuss why the leader was assassinated.
examples.zh: 歷史學家至今仍在討論這位領袖遭到暗殺的原因。

examples.en: The book tells how rebels tried to assassinate the president.
examples.zh: 這本書講述叛軍如何試圖暗殺總統。

examples.en: The astronaut waved to the crowd before boarding the rocket.
examples.zh: 太空人在登上火箭之前向群眾揮手。

examples.en: My cousin dreams of becoming an astronaut someday.
examples.zh: 我表哥夢想有一天成為太空人。

examples.en: The astronauts spent six months on the space station.
examples.zh: 太空人們在太空站待了六個月。

examples.en: The hotel gave us a booklet about local attractions.
examples.zh: 飯店給了我們一本介紹當地景點的小冊子。

examples.en: Please read the safety booklet before using the machine.
examples.zh: 使用機器之前，請先閱讀安全手冊。

examples.en: She designed a small booklet for the school festival.
examples.zh: 她為校慶設計了一本小冊子。

examples.en: Many customers decided to boycott the store after the scandal.
examples.zh: 醜聞爆發後，許多顧客決定抵制那家商店。

examples.en: Some fans threatened to boycott the concert over high ticket prices.
examples.zh: 有些粉絲因為票價太高而揚言杯葛這場演唱會。

examples.en: The group urged people to boycott products made with child labor.
examples.zh: 這個團體呼籲大眾抵制使用童工生產的產品。

examples.en: The boycott lasted for several months until the store improved working conditions.
examples.zh: 這次抵制行動持續了好幾個月，直到那家商店改善工作條件才結束。

examples.en: Students called for a boycott of the cafeteria.
examples.zh: 學生們呼籲杯葛學生餐廳。

examples.en: The company lost money because of the consumer boycott.
examples.zh: 這家公司因為消費者的抵制而虧損。

examples.en: The official was fired for taking a bribe.
examples.zh: 那名官員因為收賄而被解僱。

examples.en: He refused the bribe and reported it to the authorities.
examples.zh: 他拒絕了賄款，並向主管機關舉報。

examples.en: A bribe is against the law in almost every country.
examples.zh: 在幾乎每個國家，行賄都是違法的。

examples.en: It is illegal to bribe a police officer.
examples.zh: 賄賂警察是違法的。

examples.en: The businessman tried to bribe the inspector with a gift.
examples.zh: 那名商人試圖用禮物賄賂檢查員。

examples.en: My little sister tried to bribe me with candy.
examples.zh: 我妹妹想用糖果收買我。

examples.en: We sat by the brook and listened to the water.
examples.zh: 我們坐在小溪旁聽著流水聲。

examples.en: A small brook runs behind our grandparents' house.
examples.zh: 我們祖父母家後面有一條小溪流過。

examples.en: The children jumped across the brook to reach the other side.
examples.zh: 孩子們跳過小溪到對岸去。

examples.en: You may use a calculator during the math exam.
examples.zh: 數學考試時，你可以使用計算機。

examples.en: I forgot to bring my calculator to class.
examples.zh: 我忘了把計算機帶來上課。

examples.en: The calculator on my phone is easy to use.
examples.zh: 我手機上的計算機很好用。

examples.en: The little boy wore a red cape and pretended to be a hero.
examples.zh: 小男孩披著紅色披風，假裝自己是英雄。

examples.en: We took a boat ride around the cape.
examples.zh: 我們搭船繞行那個海角。

examples.en: A long black cape covered her shoulders in the cold wind.
examples.zh: 寒風中，一件黑色長斗篷罩住了她的肩膀。

examples.en: The caption under the photo explains where it was taken.
examples.zh: 照片下方的圖說解釋了拍攝地點。

examples.en: I wrote a funny caption for my vacation picture.
examples.zh: 我為我的度假照片寫了一段有趣的說明文字。

examples.en: Turn on the captions if you cannot hear the dialogue.
examples.zh: 如果聽不清楚對白，請開啟字幕。

examples.en: The editor will caption each photo in the magazine.
examples.zh: 編輯會替雜誌裡的每張照片加上說明文字。

examples.en: Students were asked to caption the pictures in English.
examples.zh: 學生被要求用英文為這些圖片加上說明。

examples.en: She captioned the video with a short message.
examples.zh: 她在影片上加了一段簡短的說明文字。

examples.en: The cashier gave me my change and a receipt.
examples.zh: 收銀員把零錢和收據遞給我。

examples.en: My sister works as a cashier at a supermarket.
examples.zh: 我姊姊在超市當收銀員。

examples.en: Please pay the cashier near the exit.
examples.zh: 請在出口附近向收銀員結帳。

examples.en: There were no casualties in the traffic accident.
examples.zh: 這場車禍沒有人傷亡。

examples.en: The storm caused many casualties in the coastal town.
examples.zh: 暴風雨在海邊小鎮造成許多傷亡。

examples.en: Small shops were the first casualty of the new mall.
examples.zh: 小商店成了這家新購物中心的第一批受害者。

examples.en: The caterpillar slowly crawled along the green leaf.
examples.zh: 那隻毛毛蟲沿著綠葉慢慢爬行。

examples.en: A caterpillar will eventually turn into a butterfly or a moth.
examples.zh: 毛毛蟲最終會變成蝴蝶或蛾。

examples.en: My daughter found a hairy caterpillar in the garden.
examples.zh: 我女兒在花園裡發現一隻長滿細毛的毛毛蟲。

examples.en: Workers mixed sand, gravel, water, and cement to make concrete.
examples.zh: 工人把沙、碎石、水和水泥混合來製作混凝土。

examples.en: The road was repaired with fresh cement.
examples.zh: 這條路用新的水泥修補好了。

examples.en: A bag of cement is heavy for one person to lift.
examples.zh: 一袋水泥對一個人來說很重，不好搬。

examples.en: They cemented the stones together to build a wall.
examples.zh: 他們把石頭用水泥黏合起來砌成一道牆。

examples.en: Working together on the school festival cemented our friendship.
examples.zh: 一起籌辦校慶鞏固了我們的友誼。

examples.en: The two countries signed a deal to cement their relationship.
examples.zh: 兩國簽署協議來鞏固彼此的關係。

examples.en: The chemist tested the water for harmful substances.
examples.zh: 化學家檢測水中是否含有有害物質。

examples.en: My aunt is a chemist who works for a pharmaceutical company.
examples.zh: 我阿姨是一位在製藥公司工作的化學家。

examples.en: Ask the chemist if this medicine is safe for children.
examples.zh: 請問藥師這種藥對小孩是否安全。

examples.en: My grandfather used to smoke a cigar after dinner.
examples.zh: 我祖父以前晚餐後會抽一根雪茄。

examples.en: The shop sells cigars from several different countries.
examples.zh: 這家店販售來自好幾個不同國家的雪茄。

examples.en: A box of cigars was the gift for his retirement party.
examples.zh: 一盒雪茄是他退休派對的禮物。

examples.en: Early explorers claimed they wanted to civilize the local people.
examples.zh: 早期的探險家聲稱他們想教化當地的居民。

examples.en: Good manners help civilize the way we treat one another.
examples.zh: 良好的禮儀有助於使我們彼此相待的方式更加文明。

examples.en: Education can civilize a society and reduce conflict.
examples.zh: 教育可以使社會更文明，也能減少衝突。

examples.en: The climax of the movie made everyone in the theater gasp.
examples.zh: 電影的高潮讓戲院裡的每個人都倒抽一口氣。

examples.en: The concert reached its climax with a fireworks show.
examples.zh: 演唱會在煙火秀中達到最高潮。

examples.en: The story builds slowly toward a surprising climax.
examples.zh: 故事慢慢鋪陳，朝著令人驚訝的高潮發展。

examples.en: The race climaxed with a dramatic photo finish.
examples.zh: 比賽在驚險的衝線中達到高潮，須靠終點攝影判定勝負。

examples.en: The festival climaxes on the last night with a parade.
examples.zh: 節慶在最後一晚以遊行達到高潮。

examples.en: Tension in the play climaxes in the final scene.
examples.zh: 這齣戲的緊張氣氛在最後一幕達到頂點。

senses.zh: 比較的；相對的；比較級的

examples.en: She is studying comparative literature at university.
examples.zh: 她在大學學習比較文學。

examples.en: We enjoyed the comparative quiet of the countryside.
examples.zh: 我們很享受鄉間相對的寧靜。

examples.en: The teacher explained the comparative form of the adjective.
examples.zh: 老師解釋了這個形容詞的比較級形式。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to write a comparative for each adjective.
examples.zh: 老師要我們為每個形容詞寫出一個比較級。

examples.en: Students must choose the correct comparative in this exercise.
examples.zh: 學生必須在這個練習中選出正確的比較級。

examples.en: Use a comparative when you compare two things.
examples.zh: 比較兩件事物時要用比較級。

examples.en: The program can compute the total cost in seconds.
examples.zh: 這個程式可以在幾秒內計算出總費用。

examples.en: Students learn how to compute the area of a circle.
examples.zh: 學生學習如何計算圓的面積。

examples.en: It is hard to compute how much time we will need.
examples.zh: 很難估算我們會需要多少時間。

examples.en: The letter B is a consonant, not a vowel.
examples.zh: 字母 B 是子音，不是母音。

examples.en: This word has three consonants in a row.
examples.zh: 這個字有連續三個子音。

examples.en: Students practice pronouncing each consonant clearly during their English lessons.
examples.zh: 學生在英文課上練習把每個子音念清楚。

examples.en: She tried to cram too many clothes into her small suitcase.
examples.zh: 她想把太多衣服塞進她的小行李箱。

examples.en: Many students cram the night before an exam.
examples.zh: 許多學生在考試前一晚臨時抱佛腳。

examples.en: Several passengers crammed into the elevator before the doors closed.
examples.zh: 幾位乘客在電梯門關上前擠進了電梯。

examples.en: He used a crutch to walk after the surgery.
examples.zh: 他手術後靠一支拐杖走路。

examples.en: The nurse helped her adjust the height of the crutches.
examples.zh: 護理師幫她調整拐杖的高度。

examples.en: Some people use social media as a crutch when they feel lonely.
examples.zh: 有些人覺得孤單時，會把社群媒體當成依靠。

examples.en: The lion cub stayed close to its mother.
examples.zh: 那隻幼獅緊靠在牠媽媽身邊。

examples.en: We saw a bear cub playing near the river.
examples.zh: 我們看到一隻小熊在河邊玩耍。

examples.en: The zoo announced the birth of two tiger cubs.
examples.zh: 動物園宣布兩隻幼虎誕生了。

examples.en: My mother put sliced cucumber in the salad.
examples.zh: 我媽媽在沙拉裡加了切片的小黃瓜。

examples.en: A cucumber is mostly made of water.
examples.zh: 小黃瓜的成分大部分是水。

examples.en: Do you want a cucumber sandwich for lunch?
examples.zh: 你午餐想吃小黃瓜三明治嗎？

examples.en: Farmers in this area cultivate rice and sweet potatoes.
examples.zh: 這個地區的農夫種植稻米和地瓜。

examples.en: It takes time to cultivate good study habits.
examples.zh: 培養良好的讀書習慣需要時間。

examples.en: She cultivated a friendship with her new neighbor.
examples.zh: 她與新鄰居建立起了友誼。

examples.en: Add a little detergent to the washing machine.
examples.zh: 在洗衣機裡加一點洗衣精。

examples.en: This dish detergent is gentle on your hands.
examples.zh: 這款洗碗精對雙手很溫和。

examples.en: We ran out of detergent, so I need to buy more.
examples.zh: 我們的洗衣精用完了，所以我得再買一些。
